descriptionHtml:
思路 / Approach · OAT-01 Signing In & Session Security · S15 「服务器上的审计行：每类动作一行，以及不留行的病人读取（直接读、交接收件人、记日志失败）」 Audit rows at the server: one per action class, and patient reads that leave no row (direct reads, a handoff recipient, a failed log call)

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • U5 Every patient access is recorded in the audit log and attributed to the signed-in physician. Each row has the patient, the physician, a timestamp and the action (view / save / generate / handoff send …（UAT OAT-01 step 5；UAT OAT-01 Expected；TFA-94513 AC 7；TFA-94513 AC 12；UAT 3.3） — gate: blocked: TFA-94513 in progress

测试设计方法：错误推测（error-guessing） — 专门去撞最容易出错的地方（失败、重复点、两个标签页、时钟不对、注入的指令）。

Given API clients for two fresh @roundai.test physicians on the local stack, each with one Hospital patient and one Nursing Home resident; the model call intercepted so no live AI call is made (e2e/support/action-observer.ts)

When (a) In Hospital and in Nursing Home: call the pre-round save, the note-generate action and handoffs send (to the second physician) directly. (b) Call rounding.get and snf.get for the caller's own patient without calling logChartAccess. (c) The recipient opens the handoff detail. …

Then (a) One row per action matching S14's predicates, each with patient_id, actor_id, _creationTime and an action/op that tells view, save, generate and handoff send apart. (b) A PHI_READ row with patient_id and actor_id for each read. (c) One row per patient in the handoff, with actor_id = the recipient. …

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：U5 per cell, with Q6 for the mapping of stored fields to actions and Q14 for which reads count. Expected today: (a) generate and handoff send fail as 'known: TFA-94513 AC 7/12'; (b) fails, because convex/access.ts states that a direct rounding.get with a valid session leaves no row; …

在哪跑：本地 newspec-a（新写的 Playwright）；测试方法 API · 接口（Convex 函数）；矩阵里排的车道 现成测试（Tim 的 Playwright）（blocked）

S15 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/OAT-01.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

环境：本地 — main e02167f，本地栈（local stack, not a deployed build）；run folder runs/2026-10-14-local，lane newspec-a。

测试方法：API · 接口（Convex 函数）；辅助：CODEREVIEW · 代码审查 — 按 cases/test-methods.json 的分类，分类说在 local 跑；来源：newspec-a。

UAT item: OAT-01 Signing In & Session Security · Section: B · Operational Acceptance Tests · Scenario: OAT-01/S15

Audit rows at the server: one per action class, and patient reads that leave no row (direct reads, a handoff recipient, a failed log call)

Tickets: TFA-94513 Signing In & Session Security (in progress)

本地新 lane newspec-a：newspec-a/results.json 里 status record-only → 通过（只记录（判过的都通过，其余只记录））。

怎么测（newspec-a/plan.json，automatable: partly）：New spec with two fresh physicians A and B, each with one Hospital patient and one NH resident: (a) pre-round save (rounding:update / snf:update preRoundNotes) and handoffs:send A->B per mode, then audit rows by actor; generate cell not called (Generate is forbidden on the local stack, capabilities.json) -> recorded as blocked; (b) rounding:get / snf:get without logChartAccess -> look for a PHI_READ row naming the patient; (c) B opens /handoffs and each handoff IN THE APP (B's browser), so the rows read are the ones the app's screens write; (d) browser: fail the first logChartAccess websocket call while a chart opens, see whether PHI shows; control through the same proxy must write exactly one PHI_READ row. — Everything but the generate row runs locally; the generate cell needs Generate, which is forbidden on the local stack (Quinn 2026-10-13), so it stays blocked here.

Detail:

(a) save: one PHI_WRITE row per pre-round save in Hospital and Nursing Home with patient_id, actor_id, _creationTime, op 'update', fields 'preRoundNotes' (pass on S14's predicates; whether op+fields is an acceptable 'save' is Q6). Handoff send: one row per send (resource handoffs, op 'send', count 1) with NO patient_id in either mode - known: TFA-94513 AC 7/12 (one row per patient vs a count is Q6). Generate: BLOCKED, not run (needs generate; forbidden on the local stack). (b) rounding.get / snf.get by the owner with a valid session leave no PHI_READ row (Q14). (c) the recipient B opened the inbox and both handoffs IN THE APP (own browser); the rows the app wrote are a PHI_READ 'handoffs.inbox' and a PHI_READ 'handoffs.detail' panel row per open and a PHI_WRITE 'read_receipt' per handoff, none naming a patient (Q14). (d) with the chart's logChartAccess call failed by the socket proxy (1 call seen and failed), the chart stays on screen with its name and pre-round text plus the alert 'Chart access couldn't be recorded. Check your connection and reload.'; the call is not retried and no PHI_READ row exists (Q14). Control through the same proxy with nothing failed: exactly one PHI_READ row (asserted).

只记录（recordOnly）：(b), (c), (d) wait for Q14; (a) handoff row is known TFA-94513 AC 7/12; (a) generate blocked (needs generate).

卡住的部分（blocked）：(a) generate: needs generate (forbidden on the local stack)
